name: UC LEADS Summer Research Program
description: A UC-system program for community college students transferring to UC. Provides summer research experience at a UC campus before fall enrollment. Strengthens graduate school preparation.

name: NSF Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU)
description: Paid summer research programs at universities and labs nationwide, funded by the National Science Foundation. Open to current undergraduates and recent transfers. $500–$600/week stipend typical.

name: Google STEP Internship
description: Google's Student Training in Engineering Program for first- and second-year students from underrepresented groups in tech. Paid software engineering internship at Google.

name: Microsoft Explore Internship
description: 12-week paid internship for underrepresented first- and second-year students pursuing CS or engineering. Rotational exposure to PM, SDE, and SDET roles.

name: Meta University Internship
description: Paid engineering internship for students from underrepresented backgrounds early in their university career. Includes mentorship and career development.

name: Smithsonian Institution Internship
description: Paid and unpaid internships in museums, research centers, and conservation labs across the Smithsonian network. Strong fit for history, anthropology, biology, and art students.

name: Phi Theta Kappa Honor Society Membership
description: CC honor society that unlocks hundreds of transfer scholarships and honors-in-good-standing recognition at transfer institutions. Requires 3.5+ GPA after 12 credits. Join your campus chapter.

name: DOE Science Undergraduate Laboratory Internship (SULI)
description: Paid research internship at a DOE national laboratory. For undergraduate STEM students including community college attendees. 10-week paid program with housing assistance.

name: CalFresh for Students
description: California's food assistance program for eligible community college students. Frees up income for academic resources. Apply through your county's social services or via your CC's financial aid office.

name: Community College Transfer Center Workshops
description: Your CC's transfer center offers free workshops on UC/CSU applications, personal statements, and counselor advising. Attend every semester starting in your first year.

name: LinkedIn Learning (Free via Public Library)
description: Access thousands of professional development courses for free with a library card. Builds LinkedIn profile skills and certifications in tech, business, and creative fields.

name: Udemy / Coursera Online Certifications
description: Earn industry-recognized certifications in programming, data analysis, project management, and more. Many courses are free to audit. Certifications strengthen transfer applications and resumes.

name: American Corporate Partners (ACP) Mentoring
description: Free career mentoring from corporate professionals for veterans and their spouses. Industry connections and career guidance from experienced professionals.

name: California Conservation Corps
description: Paid conservation work program for Californians 18–25. Builds environmental skills, earns education awards, and provides a path to outdoor and environmental careers.

name: AmeriCorps VISTA / City Year
description: Full-time service year with education award ($6,495+) upon completion. Builds leadership, teaching, and nonprofit skills. Counts toward grad school applications as meaningful experience.

name: California Senate Fellows Program
description: Competitive 11-month fellowship in the California State Senate for recent graduates and students. Provides deep insight into state policy and law. Ideal for political science and pre-law students.

name: White House Internship Program
description: Highly competitive paid internship in the Executive Office of the President. For undergrads passionate about public policy, law, and government. Strong extracurricular and essay required.

name: Hospital Volunteer / Clinical Shadowing Program
description: Contact your local hospital's volunteer services department to shadow physicians, nurses, and allied health professionals. Essential for pre-med, nursing, and healthcare career tracks.

name: Law School Clinic / Legal Aid Volunteer
description: Volunteer at a local law school clinic or legal aid nonprofit to gain real-world legal experience before and during your transfer. Strong signal for law school applications.

name: Student Government Association (SGA) Leadership
description: Run for or join your campus SGA. Demonstrates leadership, advocacy, and civic engagement. Strengthens transfer applications and provides scholarship eligibility.

name: Major-Specific Student Clubs
description: Join or found clubs aligned with your major (pre-med club, business club, CS club, psychology club). Leadership roles in clubs strengthen transfer applications and personal statements.

name: NASA Internship Program (NIFS)
description: Paid STEM internships at NASA centers nationwide. Open to community college students. Covers engineering, computer science, earth science, and communications roles.

name: California Apprenticeship Initiative
description: Paid apprenticeship programs in tech, construction, healthcare, and business. Earn-while-you-learn model. Recognized by the CA Division of Apprenticeship Standards.

name: Mentor Collective — Transfer Student Mentoring
description: Many UC and CSU campuses offer peer mentoring for incoming transfer students through Mentor Collective. Connect with a current upper-division student in your major before your first semester.

name: LinkedIn Profile Building Workshops
description: Your CC's career center offers free LinkedIn profile workshops. A strong LinkedIn profile is essential for landing internships and connecting with alumni at your target university.

name: Community College Honors Program
description: Many California CCs have honors programs with enhanced coursework and priority transfer pathways to UC and private institutions. Enrollment in honors courses strengthens your application significantly.

name: Tutoring / Learning Center Leadership
description: Become a peer tutor or learning assistant at your campus learning center. Paid or volunteer role that demonstrates mastery and mentorship. Strong signal on transfer applications.

name: NIH Community College Summer Enrichment Program
description: Paid summer research at NIH for community college students. Biomedical research focus with full stipend. Excellent pre-med and pre-graduate school experience.

name: California College Promise Program
description: Free tuition for first-year students at California community colleges. If eligible, this frees up financial resources for books, transportation, and supplies during your CC years.

name: Nonprofit / Social Work Internship
description: Many nonprofits in California offer semester-long internships in social services, case management, and community organizing. Check Idealist.org for current openings in your area.

name: Hackathons and Coding Competitions
description: Participate in free hackathons (MLH, HackAI, local events). Builds portfolio projects, networking contacts, and demonstrates initiative to employers and transfer schools.

name: CC Dream Resource Center
description: Most California community colleges have a Dream Resource Center (or undocumented student services) offering guidance on AB 540, DACA resources, scholarships, and transfer planning.

name: Summer Bridge / Boot Camp Programs
description: Many UC and CSU campuses offer summer bridge programs for incoming transfer students to strengthen math, writing, and study skills before the first semester begins.

name: Small Business Development Center (SBDC) Entrepreneurship
description: Free business planning, consulting, and workshops for aspiring entrepreneurs. California SBDC network supports students wanting to launch ventures while in school.

name: Extended Opportunity Programs and Services (EOPS)
description: State-funded CC program for first-gen, low-income students. Provides counseling, book vouchers, and priority registration. Extremely valuable support system — enroll if eligible.

name: CSU STEM Collaborative Pathways
description: CSU-system program connecting community college STEM students to research and mentoring opportunities at CSU campuses before transfer.
